# cvp_workspace_rollback (Action)

Roll back the workspace (REQUEST_ROLLBACK).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Invoke the rollback verb on a workspace.
action "cvp_workspace_rollback" "example" {
  config {
    workspace_id = cvp_workspace.example.workspace_id
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `workspace_id` (String) The `workspace_id` of the target workspace.
